name: plancompass-simple
description: Simple ladder for planCompass (North/compass rose on the 2D floor plan): opens the 2D plan editor, asserts the compass SVG ('North compass' title) mounts, then drives a real interaction — rotating the plan orientation via setOrientationDeg — and asserts the compass SVG's rotate() transform tracks the new orientation. planCompass is simple-tier (present in both Simple and Pro) — asserted ON in both modes.

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.()

steps.name: verify-plancompass-on-in-simple
steps.failMessage: planCompass should be ON in Simple mode (it is simple-tier)
